notes: PAN Emirates UAE: panemirates.com is a marketing redirect (HTTP 403->follow) to www.panhomestores.com/uae_en/ (Al Seer Group's rebranded UAE storefront, ScandiPWA/Magento 2 GraphQL backend, store_code uae_en, category_url_suffix none) -- this IS the correct current site for the company, confirmed by following the redirect directly. ROBOTS.TXT: 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /' -- a blanket disallow for ALL agents (not Claude-specific; no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web/Claude-User carve-out), so per Rule 3 this is treated as an ordinary WAF-protected site, not a must-decline case. ACCESS: the whole origin (homepage, robots.txt, /graphql) sits behind a Cloudflare Managed Challenge (cType:'managed', Turnstile JS proof-of-work) that returned HTTP 403 'Just a moment...' to every route tried in this session: curl_cffi impersonation across 25+ Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Edge desktop+mobile profiles (GET and POST, with/without warm-up), r.jina.ai (direct and percent-encoded), translate.goog (itself returned Google's own 400 abuse-check page), and WebFetch (403). A prior interrupted attempt earlier in this same session did get real GraphQL responses through for a window of a few minutes (categories tree fully recovered down to leaf level for every in-scope branch, plus total_count and 8-item title samples for about a dozen leaf category IDs) before the challenge hardened again; this worker reused and independently corroborated only the counts whose sampled titles were verifiable against the brief's in/exclude rules (marked in each leaf's evidence), and could not re-verify or obtain the remaining ~34 leaf counts -- those are qty:null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than guessed, per the project's standing rule. Browser automation was not used (shared pool). STRUCTURE (fully recovered, high confidence): under the 'Accessories' top-nav branch (sibling 'Furniture' branch is wholly out of scope) -- Home Decor > Decor Accessories; Lighting > Lamps + childless 'Lights' (string/fairy lights) + Core Electricals (bulbs/batteries/sockets, excluded); Wall Decor > Wall Art / Mirrors / Photo Frames / Clocks; Tabletop > Dinnerware / Serveware / Drinkware / Tea and Coffee (filed under Kitchen and Dining per brief) with Flatware and Table Linen excluded; Bathroom > Bath Accessories (Bath Textiles/Storage/Shower Accessories excluded as textile/storage/fixture); Garden > Outdoor Dining & Entertaining / Garden Pots & Planters / Outdoor Textile & Decor (Faux Flowers & Plants excluded explicitly; BBQ/Camping/Outdoor Table Linen excluded); Kids Accessories > Kids Room Decor and Kids' Rooms Lighting kept in scope per Rule 0 (product type beats room/age-group name -- clocks, wall art and lighting are decor regardless of being in the kids department), all other Kids Accessories branches (soft furnishings, storage, toys, bathroom, floor coverings, eat-and-drink tableware/water-bottles, school gear, strollers) excluded as functional/textile/storage/toys, consistent with how the S.N.194 Home Centre UAE precedent (c15.json) handled the same Baby&Kids-department pattern (kept Wall Art/Lighting/Decor/Mirrors/Photo Frames/Clocks, dropped the rest). Kitchen accessories branch (cookware/bakeware/storage/linen/tools/appliances) is wholly excluded, no decor items found. Utility & Storage, Floor Covering (rugs/mats), Pets Supplies wholly excluded. A separate 'Outdoor & Garden' top-nav branch (id 3403: Silver Sky, Delmont, Contempo, Courtlands, Artisan, Raaha, Sofas Swings & Lounges, Cookout, Picnic Essentials, etc.) duplicates/overlaps the Accessories>Garden branch and is mostly furniture collection names -- dropped as a furniture/facet re-cut, not extracted separately (Rule 0.6). RULE 0 GAINS: 'Vanity & Scales' (id 280, under Bathroom) is entirely vanity mirrors on inspection (no scales in the sample) -- kept, reclassified as Mirrors. 'Decor & Storage' (id 4869, under Outdoor Textile & Decor) is entirely decorative garden stakes/resin figurines on inspection (no storage items in the sample) -- kept as decor. Kids' Rooms Lighting and Kids Room Decor kept despite the age-group/room name per Rule 0. DROPPED (inspected, not extracted): 'Garden Accessories' (id 92, under Garden Pots & Planters) is artificial/faux plants and a garden fence on inspection (boxwood balls, PVC fence, faux hanging potted plants) -- excluded as faux plants, an explicit brief exclusion, despite living under the Planters branch (Rule 0 cuts both ways: product type, not parent-node name). 'Accessories' (id 278, under Bath Accessories) is a genuine mixed roll-up on inspection -- roughly half the sampled titles are waste bins (storage) and half are trays/soap dishes (decor); dropped rather than padded per the brief's mixed-roll-up rule since the decor/storage split cannot be verified at the SKU level. 'Food Warmers & Casseroles' (id 381, under Serveware) is chafing dishes/hotpots/food warmers on inspection -- excluded as kitchen appliances despite the Serveware parent label. Fountains (id 91, Floor/Table Fountains) skipped as borderline decor-vs-fixture, consistent with the S.N.194/c15 Home Centre UAE precedent which explicitly skipped the same category for the same reason on a comparable UAE retailer. 'Shelves & Accessories' (id 134, under Wall Decor) is wall shelving, bookshelves and room dividers on inspection -- excluded as furniture, despite the Wall Decor parent label. DUPLICATE-COMPANY CHECK: not flagged in the roster's duplicate-company list; independently confirmed no overlap with any other UAE company in this window (Home Box, Home Centre UAE, Home R Us, OC Home -- all distinct domains/brands from panhomestores.com).
